description: Closes a watch; its need, constraints and alerts are erased 30 days after closing. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

watch_id.description: Watch id returned by watch_need or list_watches (w_...).

name: unwatch_need

outputSchema.description: Answer of unwatch_need and DELETE /api/watches/{id}. The need, its constraints and its alerts are erased 30 days after closed_at (deleted_on).

pending.description: Delivery on the next call: alerts that wait for this organisation. Absent when there is nothing to deliver. Only ack_alerts empties it.

summary.description: One sentence in English, or in French when the request was in French.
